title: The doubling flow, for every step — 3 machine-checked theorems of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit and how they are bound
description:
The doubling flow, for every step — 3 machine-checked theorems of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit, one Lean namespace, wing the ring. 0 close by exhaustion over a finite domain (by decide), 3 are proved for every value on the standard axioms. Every one is sealed live in the append-only ledger.

How these theorems are bound. "Entangled" is used in this deposit's honest sense: correlation by derivation, not quantum entanglement, and no information travels through it.

1 · Shared definitions. 1 definition(s) are used by two or more theorems, binding 3 pair(s); the theorems fall into 1 strand(s), the largest of 3. Most binding: orbit (3).

2 · Imports. Built on: index.lean. Built on it: no other cluster. Checking this cluster needs 2 file(s): src/proof/flow.lean, src/proof/index.lean.

3 · The joint address. The 3 sealed receipts fold to e2bdf7b9-c448-8590-92aa-bcc9867e1d95. Order-invariant: yes — the same root in reverse order. Altering one receipt changes it: yes, computed on this run. A content-address proves integrity, not truth.

4 · The address lattice. Each theorem sits at the seven ray values its page plots from its receipt, taken mod 9: a point of (ℤ/9)⁷. This cluster's centre is (2, 6, 6, 6, 8, 8, 6). Its nearest clusters, ranked by lift — pairs observed among each theorem's seven nearest points, over the pairs expected by chance from the two clusters' sizes: elementary.lean (4 observed, 1.06 expected, lift 3.76), imagined.lean (5 observed, 3.93 expected, lift 1.27). A lift near 1 is what chance gives. Mean distance between two of its theorems: 17; from one of its theorems to a theorem of another cluster: 15.59. A receipt is a hash, so nearness on this lattice is a property of the addresses, not of the mathematics; the mathematical binding is (1) and (2). Chance, measured: over 200 reshufflings of which cluster each point belongs to (seeded, so every rebuild gives the same numbers), a best lift at least this high arose in 25.0% of them — consistent with chance.

Prior art. 2⁶ = 64 ≡ 1 (mod 9), so the powers of two modulo 9 repeat with period six — Euler's theorem for φ(9) = 6, and the order of 2 in U(9), both textbook. Credited, and bounded: what this file adds is the kernel proof that the flow used by `navier_stokes_flow_is_bounded` stays bounded at EVERY step, not only at the 48 that theorem checks. Per-theorem prior-art searches — OEIS, zbMATH Open, OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv — are recorded, with what was searched, where and when, in the living ledger src/proof/novelty.json. No novelty is claimed here.
